connectorUiConfig.title: Netskope Client Status
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The Netskope Client Status connector ingests Netskope client device status records (installation, connectivity, health, and last-seen posture events) into Microsoft Sentinel via the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) REST API poller. Data is delivered by the Netskope API as CSV and stored in the `NetskopeClientStatus_CL` table. Enumeration codes are retained in their original columns and translated during ingestion into adjacent human-readable `*_name` columns.

sampleQueries.description: Get sample of Netskope Client Status records
View client status codes and their human-readable names
sampleQueries.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| project TimeGenerated, host_info_hostname, host_info_os, host_info_os_name, last_seen_device_event_status_v2, last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name, last_seen_device_event_npa_status, last_seen_device_event_npa_status_name
| take 10

sampleQueries.description: Latest status for each Netskope device
sampleQueries.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| project TimeGenerated, host_info_hostname, user_info_username, client_version, host_info_os_name, last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name, last_seen_device_event_npa_status_name, last_seen_device_event_event_name
| order by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: Devices whose client is disabled, uninstalled or dormant
sampleQueries.query:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| where last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name in ("DISABLED", "UNINSTALLED", "DORMANT")
| project TimeGenerated, host_info_hostname, user_info_username, last_seen_device_event_status_v2_name, last_seen_device_event_actor_name, last_seen_device_event_service_name, last_seen_device_event_event_name

NetskopeClientStatus_CL
| extend DeviceKey = case(isnotempty(device_hash), device_hash, isnotempty(guid), guid, isnotempty(device_id), device_id, host_info_hostname)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceKey
| summarize Devices = count() by client_version
| order by Devices desc

dataTypes.name: NetskopeClientStatus_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
NetskopeClientStatus_CL 
 | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
 | where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: Netskope organisation url
customs.description: The Netskope data connector requires you to provide your organisation url. You can find your organisation url by signing into the Netskope portal.

customs.name: Netskope API key
customs.description: The Netskope data connector requires you to provide a valid API key. You can create one by following the [Netskope documentation](https://docs.netskope.com/en/rest-api-v2-overview-312207/).

customs.name: Netskope Client Status iterator
customs.description: Unlike the other Netskope Alerts and Events data types, Client Status is only exposed through Netskope's REST API v2 Management-API iterator endpoints. There is no default or auto-created index for this data type — you must create the iterator yourself before connecting; see the [Netskope iterator endpoints documentation](https://docs.netskope.com/en/using-the-rest-api-v2-dataexport-iterator-endpoints/).

instructionSteps.title: STEP 1 - Create a Netskope API key.
instructionSteps.description: Follow the [Netskope documentation](https://docs.netskope.com/en/rest-api-v2-overview-312207/) for guidance on this step.

instructionSteps.title: STEP 2 - Create a Client Status iterator
instructionSteps.description: Client Status does not support the shared `index=` convention used by the other Netskope event types — you must create a dedicated iterator for this data type before Microsoft Sentinel can poll it. Using the [Netskope REST API v2 iterator endpoints](https://docs.netskope.com/en/using-the-rest-api-v2-dataexport-iterator-endpoints/), call the Create Iterator API once (for example `POST https://<your-org>/api/v2/dataexport/iterator/<a-name-you-choose>?eventtype=clientstatus` with your API token) and record the iterator name/ID you used — you will enter it below. Confirm the exact request shape against the linked Netskope documentation, as iterator management is a separate API surface from the events you are polling.

instructionSteps.title: STEP 3 - Enter your Netskope product Details
instructionSteps.description: Enter your Netskope organisation url, API Token, and the Client Status iterator ID you created in Step 2:
